name: dry-fixture-duplication
body:
DRY INVENTORY — duplicated scratch-repo test fixtures (verified against the branch graph, [with user]). The `mod tests` roots of several root-crate modules each define near-identical git/scratch helpers instead of sharing one:
- `with_cwd`: `rust.apg.tests.with_cwd` (`src/main.rs:2864-2875`), `rust.apg.plan_cmd.tests.with_cwd` (`src/plan_cmd.rs:2469-2479`), `rust.apg.node_cmd.tests.with_cwd` (`src/node_cmd.rs:512-522`), `rust.apg.review_cmd.tests.with_cwd` (`src/review_cmd.rs:1462-1472`) — four copies.
- `wt_commit`: `rust.apg.git.tests.wt_commit` (`src/git.rs:945-959`), `rust.apg.node_cmd.tests.wt_commit` (`src/node_cmd.rs:439-454`), `rust.apg.project_cmd.tests.wt_commit` (`src/project_cmd.rs:681-695`), plus the shared `rust.apg.testutil.wt_commit` (`src/testutil.rs:399-414`) — three copies beside the shared one.
- `wt_commit_paths`: `rust.apg.artifacts.tests.wt_commit_paths` (`src/artifacts.rs:1404-1421`), `rust.apg.plan_cmd.tests.wt_commit_paths` (`src/plan_cmd.rs:2412-2430`) — two copies.

Correction to the brief: the fourth `with_cwd` copy is in `src/review_cmd.rs`, not `src/project_cmd.rs` (project_cmd defines `wt_commit` but no `with_cwd`). The shared harness already holds `wt_commit` in `src/testutil.rs`, so the per-module copies are drift that the decomposition must converge onto the single shared harness.
